answer: Make each identity pay in the one currency agents cannot counterfeit: judged original work. Before transacting, every identity must submit reasoning a jury grades as original — a lantern that only lights when fed real oil. Plagiarism checks act as a prism, splitting each submission into a spectrum of style, structure, and timing signals so copied or templated answers stand out. This is the nadir of Sybil economics: forging N identities costs N real inference runs, while the network’s marginal verification cost per identity stays near zero.
